verdict.rationale: Warp's first-party docs say it supports themes (warp-docs-90). They also say it can generate themes automatically from a background image (warp-docs-19) and can sync the theme with the OS light/dark setting (warp-docs-20), which covers both color schemes and automatic light/dark switching. missing for 10: detail on custom theme files or color-scheme authoring and import, and independent or hands-on corroboration of theming or light/dark sync.
